## Overview

This CEP documents the harmonization of sleep variables in cchsflow for the Canadian Community Health Survey (CCHS).

**PR:** [#161 - Sleep variables](https://github.com/big-life-lab/cchsflow/pull/161)

**Status:** Ready for merge

## Sleep variables in scope

| Variable | Description | Type | Cycles |
|----------|-------------|------|--------|
| SLPG01 | Hours sleep | Categorical | 2011+ PUMF |
| SLPG01_A | Hours sleep | Categorical | 2001, 2007-2008 PUMF |
| SLPG01_B | Hours sleep | Categorical | 2011-2014 Master |
| SLPG01_C | Hours sleep | Categorical | 2001, 2015-2016 Master |
| SLPG01_cont | Hours sleep | Continuous | All available cycles |
| SLP_02 | Trouble sleeping | Categorical | 2007+ (5-point scale) |
| SLP_02_A | Trouble sleeping | Categorical | 2001 (3-point scale) |
| SLP_03 | Sleep refreshing | Categorical | 2007+ (5-point scale) |
| SLP_03_A | Sleep refreshing | Categorical | 2001 (3-point scale) |
| SLP_04 | Difficulty staying awake | Categorical | 2007+ (5-point scale) |
| SLP_04_A | Difficulty staying awake | Categorical | 2001 (3-point scale) |

## Critical finding: Ontario sleep data gap

::: {.callout-warning}
## 13-year gap confirmed

Ontario sleep data has a **13-year gap (2003-2014)** in both PUMF and Ontario Linked/Share files. This was confirmed by three independent sources:

1. **PUMF direct analysis** - .RData file validation
2. **GoogleLM cross-check** - Statistics Canada documentation review
3. **ICES Dictionary v1.0.0** - 14,005 variable availability matrix
:::

### Ontario sleep data availability

| Epoch | Years | PUMF | ONT_LINK/SHARE | Variables | Scale |
|-------|-------|------|----------------|-----------|-------|
| Early era | 2001-2002 | 2001 only | Both years | GENA_03-06, GENB_03-05 | 3-point |
| **Gap** | **2003-2014** | **None** | **None** | **Missing** | **N/A** |
| Modern era | 2015-2018 | 2015-16 only | Both years | SLP_005, SLP_010-020 | 5-point |

### Why the gap exists

- Sleep was **Optional Content** from 2007-2018
- **Ontario did NOT select** the sleep module for 2007-2014 and 2017-2018
- **Ontario DID select** the sleep module for 2015-2016 only
- This applies to both PUMF and Master/Linked files

## Cycles without sleep data (Canada-wide PUMF)

Sleep variables are **NOT available** in the following PUMF cycles for any province:

- 2003
- 2005
- 2009-2010

This was verified via DDI XML review.

## Scale incompatibility

The sleep quality variables have incompatible response scales between 2001 and 2007+:

| Era | Scale | Response options | Direction |
|-----|-------|------------------|-----------|
| 2001 | 3-point | Most of the time / Sometimes / Never | Lower = worse |
| 2007+ | 5-point | None / A little / Some / Most / All | Higher = worse |

::: {.callout-important}
## Scales are inverted

2001: 1 = "Most of the time" (worst)
2007+: 1 = "None of the time" (best)

**Do not pool** 2001 with 2007+ data without careful harmonization.
:::

### Harmonization recommendation

Create binary variable "Any trouble sleeping":
- **2001**: 1 & 2 ("Most" + "Sometimes") = Yes; 3 ("Never") = No
- **2007+**: 2-5 ("A little" to "All") = Yes; 1 ("None") = No

## Variable naming evolution

| Era | Hours | Trouble | Refreshing | Awake |
|-----|-------|---------|------------|-------|
| 2001 | GENA_03 | GENA_04 | GENA_05 | GENA_06 |
| 2002 | GENB_03 | GENB_04 | GENB_05 | Not found |
| 2007-2008 | SLP_01 | SLP_02 | SLP_03 | SLP_04 |
| 2011-2014 | SLPG01 | SLP_02 | SLP_03 | SLP_04 |
| 2015-2018 | SLPG005 | SLP_010 | SLP_015 | SLP_020 |

## Recommendations for Ontario dementia research

### PUMF analysis

| Cycle | Ontario sleep data | Notes |
|-------|-------------------|-------|
| 2001 | **Available** | 3-point scale (~9,400 Ontario 50+) |
| 2003 | Not in PUMF | Canada-wide exclusion |
| 2005 | Not in PUMF | Canada-wide exclusion |
| 2007-2008 | **NOT available** | Ontario excluded from optional module |
| 2009-2010 | Not in PUMF | Canada-wide exclusion |
| 2011-2012 | **NOT available** | Ontario excluded from optional module |
| 2013-2014 | **NOT available** | Ontario excluded from optional module |
| 2015-2016 | **Available** | 5-point scale (~14,400 Ontario 50+) |
| 2017-2018 | **NOT available** | Ontario excluded from optional module |

### ICES Linked/Share file analysis

| Cycle | Ontario sleep data | Dataset |
|-------|-------------------|---------|
| 2001 | **Available** | CCHS2001_ONT_LINK_11 |
| 2002 | **Available** | CCHS2002_ONT_LINK_12 |
| 2003-2014 | **NOT available** | N/A |
| 2015-2016 | **Available** | CCHS201516_ONT_SHARE |
| 2017-2018 | **Available** | CCHS201718_ONT_SHARE |

::: {.callout-note}
## ICES advantage

ICES Linked/Share files provide 2002 and 2017-2018 Ontario sleep data not available in PUMF.
:::
